name: Scene spike (SC1)
author: Edgemodders
description: The scene spike for EDGEdir (#50, #48, #47): walks a spawned person to a target with the game's AI move command and times the gaps between a workspot, a walk and a workspot; moves a person while they play a written workspot; plays a workspot on a person who does not carry it through a device at their feet, on a plain person and on one of the game's own; and spawns the game's cutscene copy of V, dresses it, directs it and walks it. Asks for the bridge and archives permissions, to write its workspots.
